generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractors should have valid Civil Contractor registration in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc.
Form of tender is mandatory to upload in KPPP portal
Assessed available tender capacity should be greater than amount put to tender.

SC Caste certificate and domicile certificate is mandatory to be uploaded in www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in portal as per G.O No. FD 876 Exp-12/2017 Dt:1.10.2017. failing which tender will be technically non responsive

If in two attempts of tender bidding process, Bidders belonging to SC participant is not qualified under this rule, then these works shall be tendered as open category wherein all eligible bidders of General or Scheduled castes or Schedules tribes category can participate
If contractor is the firm, then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to the SC as the case may be
